page.overview:
What is Walking Wake?

Walking Wake shares many physical traits with Suicune except it resembles a theropod-like Pokémon rather than a big cat. It still shares some of its leopard-like appearance and certain traits with Suicune, inculcating its muzzle-shape, the large purple mane, turquoise gem-shaped crown, and the spots on its body. However, it has other distinct features that is absent from Suicuine's design, such as its saurian claws and general appearance, two tails, ridged spikes, and red spines. It stands and walks upright on two large clawed white feet (fringed with blue fur-like hair) that almost resemble talons. It has thin arms and small hands with three sharp white claws. It has a large mane of purple fur covering its scaly blue body, extending from its neck; this mane is tipped at the top with reddish spiky protrusions. It has a thin, though powerfully musculed body, primarily light blue in colour, with a white belly, a white underside beneath its tails, as well as white diamond shapes lining its legs. Its white muzzle has a saurian jaw with fangs, as well as a short horn-like protrusion on its chin. It eyes are angular in shape with red irises and yellow scleras, bordered with red markings.

It is said to be a ferocious Pokémon and an "aquatic monster" by those who had studied it.

When tamed, it acts calmly around its trainers once trusting them, sleeping with its two tails curled around its body (similar to a feline).

Walking Wake is currently the only Pokémon to learn Hydro Steam.
